name: segmently-unit-economics
description: Paywall unit economics, offline: launch card, trial and fee-stack comparisons, which experiment first — no account, nothing leaves the machine.

interface.longDescription: Answers whether a price, paywall, trial, store-vs-web choice or ad budget can work, with numbers computed on your machine by segmently ue and one public-page link per scenario. No account, no network, no browser automation. Prerequisites: Node.js 22+ with npx.
defaultPrompt: Is a $19.99 monthly worth launching on the web?
Compare a 7-day free trial with no trial for my weekly plan.
Which paywall experiment should I run first?
